_comment: Schema-VALID but accessibility-INVALID on purpose. Accepts only speech input (violates A11Y-3, excluding P2 and P4) and sets requires_speech=true (violates A11Y-6). This fixture proves the accessibility gate actually catches exclusion that the schema alone would let through.
